youtube.description:
Claude Code subagents let you split a big job into parallel helpers. Here are 3 steps, with a prompt to copy.

Claude Code subagents run jobs in parallel, not one by one. Here are the three steps.

1. Describe - Describe a big job with separate parts, like tests and README.
2. Delegate - Ask Claude to use subagents.
3. Merge - They run in parallel, and summaries return to you. Use git to undo changes.

Needs: Paid plans or Console

Official docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
